name: io.github.chrischall/angi-mcp
description: Angi for Claude — find home-service pros by trade and city, read ratings and reviews

environmentVariables.name: ANGI_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for verbose bridge logging to stderr.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator (default 127.0.0.1; a literal IP only). For a hosted child in its own network namespace only — never bind a laptop's concentrator to the network.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where fetchproxy stores its long-term identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/). For a host that runs a separate child per caller, so they share one identity.
